name: NGC 7714, host of SN 2007fo (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 7714, a starburst spiral galaxy that hosted the supernova SN 2007fo, seen by Hubble.
label: sn2007fo-hubble
story: A spiral galaxy bursting with new stars after a close brush with its neighbor NGC 7715, which pulled out a ring and long tails of stars. In 2007 a massive star exploded near its nucleus as the Type Ib supernova SN 2007fo.

claims.text: SN 2007fo, a type Ib supernova, exploded in NGC 7714
SN 2007fo was found in the nucleus of NGC 7714 in 2007 and is type Ib
NGC 7714 is a spiral, Wolf-Rayet starburst galaxy
NGC 7714 and NGC 7715 interacted; the pair is Arp 284
A ring and two long tails of stars emerged from NGC 7714
